basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old environmental science graduate currently working as a research assistant in Melbourne, Australia. My journey into Buddhism began about a year ago when I started looking for ways to reconcile my environmental anxieties with a more peaceful state of mind. I enjoy playing MLB The Show in my leisure time and have recently gotten into collecting vinyl records. I am single and typically online during the evenings after work, exploring new hobbies and engaging in thoughtful discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Environmental Science and have always been passionate about ecological conservation. I am self-taught in some aspects of Buddhism, mostly through online courses and reading. My involvement with environmental activism has strengthened my understanding of both human and ecological systems.
